NAME: PWM verification plan
details: Source: GARUDA-PWM-SPEC-001, section 2 (requirements), section 10 (assertions) and section 11 (verification plan), written with the specification. Moved into vPlanner form on 2026-10-04; section 4 holds what the 2026-10-04 flow run added.

NAME: Requirements
details: From section 2 of the specification; planned tests from section 11.

NAME: R-1 Produce a pulse of programmable width at a programmable period ...
details: Produce a pulse of programmable width at a programmable period, accurate to one tick.
implementation_note: Source: SYS §6.4

NAME: t_pwm_width
details: Oracle: measured widths of 100/200/300/400 ticks
implementation_note: Status in the specification: pass. Bench: tb/pwm/tb_pwm.sv, checks tagged [R-1] (widths at lines 149-152, edge widths DUTY 1 / PERIOD-1 / 0) - 7 checks, all PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression.

NAME: t_pwm_servo
details: Oracle: a 1.5 ms pulse in a 20 ms frame measures 1.5 ms
implementation_note: Status in the specification: pass. Bench: tb/pwm/tb_pwm.sv, check [R-1] 1.5 ms servo pulse (line 240) and the [N-7.1] frame checks - 3 checks, all PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression.

NAME: R-2 Four channels with independent duty and independent enable.
details: Four channels with independent duty and independent enable.
implementation_note: Source: SYS §6.4

NAME: t_pwm_indep
details: Oracle: four different duties at once; disabling one leaves the rest
implementation_note: Status in the specification: pass. Bench: tb/pwm/tb_pwm.sv, checks tagged [R-2] (lines 155, 187) and [N-6.1] per-channel enables - 3 checks, all PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression.

NAME: R-3 All four channels share one time base their rising edges are ...
details: All four channels share one time base; their rising edges are aligned.
implementation_note: Source: [N-7.2]

NAME: t_pwm_aligned
details: Oracle: all four rise in the same cycle
implementation_note: Status in the specification: pass. Bench: tb/pwm/tb_pwm.sv, checks tagged [R-3] and [N-7.2] (lines 160, 313) - 2 checks, all PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression.

NAME: R-4 Word-only APB never stalls.
details: Word-only APB, never stalls.
implementation_note: Source: AHB2APB [N-7.12], [N-7.15]

NAME: t_pwm_regs
details: Oracle: registers read back; PSLVERR on unmapped; PREADY always high
implementation_note: Status in the specification: pass. Bench: tb/pwm/tb_pwm.sv, checks tagged [R-4] plus the ID read (lines 115-122, 473+) - 9 checks, all PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression.

NAME: R-5 A duty written mid-pulse must never shorten the pulse in progress.
details: A duty written mid-pulse must never shorten the pulse in progress.
implementation_note: Source: [N-7.3]

NAME: t_pwm_doublebuf
details: Oracle: a mid-pulse write does not shorten the pulse in progress, and no runt appears
implementation_note: Status in the specification: pass. Bench: tb/pwm/tb_pwm.sv, checks tagged [R-5] and [N-7.3] (line 171 onward) - 6 checks, all PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression.

NAME: R-6 Outputs low at reset low when disabled and low within one cycle ...
details: Outputs low at reset, low when disabled, and low within one cycle of EN clearing.
implementation_note: Source: Board safety

NAME: t_pwm_reset
details: Oracle: low in reset, low before enable, low when configured but disabled
implementation_note: Status in the specification: pass. Bench: tb/pwm/tb_pwm.sv, checks tagged [N-9.2], [N-6.1] and the [R-6] low-before-enable checks (lines 109-133, 508) - 9 checks, all PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression.

NAME: t_pwm_stop
details: Oracle: clearing EN mid-pulse drops all four within one cycle
implementation_note: Status in the specification: pass. Bench: tb/pwm/tb_pwm.sv, checks tagged [N-7.5] and [R-6] clearing EN mid-pulse (lines 197, 393) - 5 checks, all PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression.

NAME: R-7 A duty wider than the period is clamped and reported not left ...
details: A duty wider than the period is clamped and reported, not left undefined.
implementation_note: Source: [N-7.4]

NAME: t_pwm_clamp
details: Oracle: DUTY > PERIOD clamps to 100%, sets STATUS[16] and IRQSTAT[1], and self-clears
implementation_note: Status in the specification: pass. Bench: tb/pwm/tb_pwm.sv, checks tagged [R-7] and [N-7.4] (lines 208-214, 368) - 7 checks, all PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression.

NAME: R-8 Period and duty resolution adequate for 50 Hz servo and 4 kHz ...
details: Period and duty resolution adequate for 50 Hz servo and 4 kHz OneShot125.
implementation_note: Source: SYS §6.4

NAME: t_pwm_prescale
details: Oracle: PRESCALE = 9 makes 25 ticks measure 2 µs
implementation_note: Status in the specification: pass. Bench: tb/pwm/tb_pwm.sv, checks tagged [R-8] (line 222, PRESCALE 0xFFFF) - 4 checks, all PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression.

NAME: R-9 One held level interrupt to CLIC ID 21.
details: One held, level interrupt to CLIC ID 21.
implementation_note: Source: CLIC §7.2, D-17

NAME: t_pwm_irq
details: Oracle: clamp interrupt asserts and is held
implementation_note: Status in the specification: pass. Bench: tb/pwm/tb_pwm.sv, checks tagged [R-9] (lines 209, 404, 418) - 3 checks, all PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression.

NAME: Planned tests not tied to one requirement
t_chip_pwm
details: Oracle: all four pins from the core, through the real fabric
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: NOT IMPLEMENTED - no check for this test found in sw/chip/t_chip_periph.c and tb/soc/tb_chip.sv. sw/chip/t_chip_periph.c step 3 only checks that the STATUS counter advances and tb_chip.sv does not observe pwm0..pwm3; chip_periph itself RESULT: PASSED.

NAME: a_low_when_off
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. Checked procedurally in tb/pwm/tb_pwm.sv ([N-6.1] no output was ever high without CTRL.EN and its own enable, line 524).

NAME: a_aligned
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. Checked procedurally in tb/pwm/tb_pwm.sv ([R-3] line 160, [N-7.2] line 313).

NAME: a_pready
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. Checked procedurally in tb/pwm/tb_pwm.sv ([R-4] PREADY high in every cycle of every access, line 543).

NAME: PWM-1 17-bit period compare
details: HAL ULRELE: (cnt_q + 1) >= period_i was evaluated in 16 bits and would wrap at cnt_q = 0xFFFF; unreachable today, now a 17-bit compare.
implementation_note: FIXED (hardening, no behaviour change). Covered by tb_pwm [R-8] PERIOD 0xFFFF frame and DUTY = PERIOD = 0xFFFF checks (lines 440+); all PASS.

NAME: TB-28 clamp release mis-sequenced
details: The PWM clamp-release check read a pulse width before one whole pulse at the new duty had completed.
implementation_note: FIXED (testbench). Check [N-7.4] the flags clear by themselves at the boundary, tb_pwm.sv; PASS.

NAME: Bench checks added
details: Check count before and after: 26 -> 56, and 58 after the merge. Two more checks come from the APB protocol checker (tb/common/apb_checker.v) bound on this bench's config port on 2026-10-03.
implementation_note: The bench grew from 26 to 56 checks, 58 with the APB checker (sim/tb_pwm/run.log: checks=58 FAIL=0), adding the [N-6.1] [N-7.x] [N-9.2] and boundary-value checks.
